feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
entry.summary: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

entry.title: Got a canceled flight? 7 clever ways to get rebooked fast
entry.summary: Flying somewhere for Thanksgiving or the holidays? Travel insiders explain what to do if your flight gets canceled or delayed — so you can quickly get to your destination.

entry.title: How the East Potomac golf course became a D.C. landmark — and what could happen to it
entry.summary: A federal judge is keeping East Potomac Park open for now, but hasn't ordered the government to keep the municipal golf course operational.

entry.title: They tried to torture him into leaving Iraq. He refused to abandon the nature he protects
entry.summary: Iran-backed militias kidnapped and tortured him, but Jassim al-Asadi is still on a mission to save Iraq's marshes, and a way of life stretching back to the dawn of history.

entry.title: She retired early to care for family. New work rules for food aid disrupted that
entry.summary: The Trump administration's sweeping changes to SNAP food aid mean older adults up to age 65 must work or volunteer to get the benefit.

entry.title: Families of victims of D.C.-area midair collision push for more safety measures
entry.summary: Families of people killed in a midair crash in Washington, D.C., pushed lawmakers for more safety measures, amid the Trump administration calls for $50 billion after Friday's nationwide ground stop.

entry.title: Nvidia needs more than a new CEO. An expert offers a way forward
entry.summary: Nvidia needs a new CEO. Keeping its engineers is another story.

entry.title: A Van Gogh could break auction records. An art recovery lawyer sees a darker history
entry.summary: A Van Gogh bursting with color could fetch $180 million tonight. An art recovery lawyer says the dispute exposes a history the art market has long tried to bury.

entry.title: Rubio says there's 'zero' information that U.S. outages are caused by a malign actor
entry.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio sought to calm Americans as he traveled with President Trump and they prepared for key meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

entry.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
entry.summary: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.
